bead.title: Preserve stable change-record idempotency across re-emission
bead.description: PROBLEM: TD-008 CL-3 says crash/failover re-emission must dedupe by stable record identity instead of broker offset. Verify the fjord-bound path (ADR-014 embedded shape) preserves the per-record identity across re-emission: record key {item_id}:{backend_epoch}:{sequence} stable for the same logical record, re-emitted records appear at later offsets, and a stock consumer deduping on the key over the documented window observes each logical record's effect exactly once.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestKafkaIdempotencyKeyIsStableAcrossReemit` proves the emitted identity stays `(tenant_id, queue_id, item_id, backend_epoch, sequence)`.
2. `TestKafkaOffsetAdvanceDoesNotChangeDedupKey` proves a later broker offset does not alter the logical dedupe key.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestKafkaIdempotencyKeyIsStableAcrossReemit|TestKafkaOffsetAdvanceDoesNotChangeDedupKey'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
